Not for trivial edits, typos, or throwaway one-off scripts — those do not need the full loop.

invocationCandidates.text: Derived from [Andrej Karpathy's observations](https://x.com/karpathy/status/2015883857489522876) on LLM coding pitfalls. This is **not just guidelines** — it ships Python tools that detect violations, a review agent, a slash command, and a pre-commit hook.
`/karpathy-check` — Run the full 4-principle review on your staged changes.
`karpathy-reviewer` — Runs all 4 principles against a diff. Dispatched by `/karpathy-check` or manually before committing.
